metadata.description: Disease-Specific Response Criteria for Oncology SAPs

RANO.name: RANO (Response Assessment in Neuro-Oncology)
RANO.reference: Wen et al. J Clin Oncol 2010

measurable_disease.definition: Contrast-enhancing lesion ≥10mm in two perpendicular diameters

CR.name: Complete Response
criteria: Complete disappearance of all enhancing measurable disease
Off corticosteroids (or on physiologic replacement only)

PR.name: Partial Response
criteria: ≥50% decrease in sum of products of perpendicular diameters of all measurable enhancing lesions

SD.name: Stable Disease
criteria: Does not qualify for CR, PR, or progression

PD.name: Progressive Disease
criteria: ≥25% increase in sum of products of perpendicular diameters of enhancing lesions
OR any new measurable enhancing lesion
OR clear clinical deterioration not attributable to other causes
OR significant increase in T2/FLAIR non-enhancing lesion
Criteria met on stable or increased corticosteroid dose

pseudoprogression.definition: Apparent radiologic worsening within 12 weeks of radiation completion that stabilizes/improves without treatment change
pseudoprogression.handling: Continue treatment; confirm progression on subsequent scan ≥4 weeks later

pseudoresponse.definition: Rapid decrease in enhancement after antiangiogenic therapy (e.g., bevacizumab)
pseudoresponse.handling: Monitor T2/FLAIR changes; evaluate non-enhancing tumor progression

special_considerations.corticosteroid_use: Must document dose; affects response classification
special_considerations.clinical_status: Neurological examination required at each assessment
special_considerations.bevacizumab_trials: RANO criteria with emphasis on T2/FLAIR progression

Lugano.name: Lugano Classification
Lugano.reference: Cheson et al. J Clin Oncol 2014

fdg_avid_lymphomas.timing: Interim (after 2-4 cycles) and End of Treatment

nodal_disease.measurement: CT: Long axis for nodal, short axis for extranodal

splenic_involvement.definition: Splenomegaly >13cm in craniocaudal length OR focal lesions

scores.5: Uptake markedly higher than liver and/or new lesions

CMR.name: Complete Metabolic Response (FDG-avid) / Complete Response (non-FDG-avid)
CMR.pet_criteria: Deauville score 1, 2, or 3 (no metabolically active disease)
ct_criteria: Target nodes/masses regressed to ≤1.5cm in LDi
Bone marrow: No FDG-avid disease in marrow

PMR.name: Partial Metabolic Response / Partial Response
PMR.pet_criteria: Deauville score 4 or 5 with reduced uptake from baseline
ct_criteria: ≥50% decrease in SPD of up to 6 measurable nodes

NMR.name: No Metabolic Response / Stable Disease
NMR.pet_criteria: Deauville score 4 or 5 with no significant change from baseline
ct_criteria: <50% decrease in SPD of target lesions

PMD.name: Progressive Metabolic Disease / Progressive Disease
pet_criteria: Deauville score 4 or 5 with increased uptake from baseline
ct_criteria: Individual node/lesion increase ≥50% in PPD from nadir
OR increase in LDi or SDi by ≥0.5cm for lesions ≤2cm

bone_marrow_assessment.fdg_avid: PET-CT may replace bone marrow biopsy if diffusely positive
bone_marrow_assessment.non_fdg_avid: Bone marrow biopsy required if clinically indicated

special_considerations.interim_pet: Used for early response assessment; may guide therapy modification
special_considerations.residual_mass: Common in lymphoma; PET determines metabolic activity
special_considerations.thymic_rebound: May mimic residual disease on PET in young patients

PCWG3.name: PCWG3 (Prostate Cancer Working Group 3)
PCWG3.reference: Scher et al. J Clin Oncol 2016

psa_response.definition: ≥50% decline from baseline confirmed ≥3 weeks later
psa_response.confirmation: Second PSA value ≥3 weeks after first qualifying decline

definition: Confirmed by second value ≥3 weeks later
psa_progression.flare_provision: PSA flare in first 12 weeks should not trigger discontinuation

psa_endpoints.waterfall_timepoint: Maximum PSA decline at any time point

response_categories.CR: Complete disappearance of all measurable soft tissue disease
response_categories.SD: Neither PR nor PD criteria met
response_categories.PD: ≥20% increase in sum of diameters AND ≥5mm absolute increase OR new lesion

progression_definition: ≥2 new bone lesions on first scan post-baseline
MUST be confirmed on second scan ≥6 weeks later showing ≥2 additional new lesions (total ≥4 new)

flare.definition: Apparent new lesions in first 12 weeks due to treatment effect

bone_assessment.response: Bone lesions are not considered to respond (only stable or progressing)

soft_tissue_and_bone.CR: Soft tissue CR AND no new bone lesions
soft_tissue_and_bone.PR: Soft tissue PR AND no new bone lesions
soft_tissue_and_bone.SD: Soft tissue SD AND no new bone lesions
soft_tissue_and_bone.PD: Any soft tissue PD OR confirmed bone progression

rPFS.name: Radiographic Progression-Free Survival
rPFS.definition: Time to first radiographic progression (soft tissue or bone) or death

ctc_count.conversion: Change from unfavorable to favorable at Week 12

irRECIST.name: irRECIST (Immune-related RECIST)
irRECIST.reference: Nishino et al. Clin Cancer Res 2017
irRECIST.rationale: Modified RECIST to accommodate atypical response patterns in immunotherapy
key_differences_from_recist: New lesions do not automatically indicate PD
Tumor burden includes new lesion measurements

irCR.name: Immune-related Complete Response
irCR.criteria: Complete disappearance of all measurable and new lesions, confirmed ≥4 weeks

irPR.name: Immune-related Partial Response
irPR.criteria: ≥30% decrease in total tumor burden (including new measurable lesions), confirmed ≥4 weeks

irSD.name: Immune-related Stable Disease
irSD.criteria: Does not meet irCR, irPR, or irPD

irPD.name: Immune-related Progressive Disease
criteria: ≥20% increase in total tumor burden (sum of all target + new measurable lesions)

new_lesions.handling: Measure and add to total tumor burden
new_lesions.threshold: New lesion ≥10mm (or ≥15mm for lymph nodes) becomes measurable
new_lesions.documentation: Record new lesions separately for analysis

confirmation_requirement.irPD: Must confirm progression ≥4 weeks after initial assessment

pseudoprogression.definition: Initial apparent increase in tumor burden followed by response
pseudoprogression.management: Continue treatment if clinically stable; re-assess in 4-8 weeks

iRECIST.name: iRECIST
iRECIST.indication: Immunotherapy clinical trials (RECIST Working Group consensus)
iRECIST.description: Modification of RECIST 1.1 by the official RECIST Working Group for immunotherapy

iCR.name: Immune Complete Response
iCR.criteria: Disappearance of all target lesions, any pathological lymph nodes <10mm

iPR.name: Immune Partial Response
iPR.criteria: ≥30% decrease in sum of diameters of target lesions

iSD.name: Immune Stable Disease
iSD.criteria: Neither sufficient shrinkage for iPR nor sufficient increase for iPD

iUPD.name: Immune Unconfirmed Progressive Disease
criteria: ≥20% increase in sum of diameters AND ≥5mm absolute increase

iCPD.name: Immune Confirmed Progressive Disease
criteria: Confirmation of iUPD on next assessment
Further increase in tumor burden OR additional new lesions

options: Continue treatment and reassess in 4-8 weeks
unconfirmed_progression_handling.clinical_stability: Patient must be clinically stable to continue beyond iUPD

new_lesions_irecist.measurement: Must be measurable (≥10mm, ≥15mm for lymph nodes)
new_lesions_irecist.confirmation: Additional new lesions on next scan confirm iCPD

best_overall_response.non_cr_non_pd: iSD or better achieved before iUPD can be BOR if iUPD not confirmed

measurable_disease.serum_free_light_chain: Involved FLC ≥10 mg/dL with abnormal ratio

sCR.name: Stringent Complete Response
criteria: Absence of clonal plasma cells by immunohistochemistry or flow cytometry

CR.name: Complete Response
criteria: Negative immunofixation on serum and urine

VGPR.name: Very Good Partial Response
criteria: Serum and urine M-protein detectable by immunofixation but not electrophoresis

PR.name: Partial Response
criteria: AND ≥90% reduction in 24-hour urine M-protein (or <200 mg/24 hours)
If measurable soft tissue plasmacytoma: ≥50% reduction
If only measurable by FLC: ≥50% decrease in difference between involved and uninvolved FLC

SD.name: Stable Disease
SD.criteria: Not meeting criteria for sCR, CR, VGPR, PR, MR, or PD

PD.name: Progressive Disease
criteria: ≥25% increase from lowest confirmed response in serum M-protein (absolute increase ≥0.5 g/dL)
OR urine M-protein (absolute increase ≥200 mg/24 hours)
OR difference between involved and uninvolved FLC (absolute increase ≥10 mg/dL)
OR bone marrow plasma cell percentage (absolute increase ≥10%)
OR definite new bone lesion or soft tissue plasmacytoma
OR definite increase in existing plasmacytoma or bone lesion

mrd_assessment.mrd_negative: No clonal plasma cells detected at specified sensitivity

GCIG_CA125.name: GCIG CA-125 Response Criteria
GCIG_CA125.indication: Ovarian, Fallopian Tube, and Primary Peritoneal Cancer
GCIG_CA125.reference: Rustin et al. Int J Gynecol Cancer 2011

ca125_response.definition: ≥50% reduction in CA-125 from pretreatment sample
requirements: Pretreatment sample ≥2× upper limit of normal
Confirmed by repeat sample ≥28 days later

criteria: OR CA-125 ≥2× ULN if never normalized

from_baseline.criteria: Serial rise in CA-125 (≥2 samples) during treatment
from_baseline.date_of_progression: Date of first sample showing rise

combined_response.pr: CA-125 response OR RECIST PR (without other PD)
combined_response.sd: Neither response nor progression by either criterion

special_considerations.maintenance_therapy: Rising CA-125 alone may prompt switch to next-line therapy
special_considerations.parp_inhibitors: CA-125 fluctuations common; correlate with imaging

RANO_BM.name: RANO-BM (Response Assessment in Neuro-Oncology - Brain Metastases)

CR.name: Complete Response
criteria: Complete disappearance of all CNS target lesions

PR.name: Partial Response
criteria: ≥30% decrease in sum of longest diameters of CNS target lesions

SD.name: Stable Disease
SD.criteria: Does not qualify for CR, PR, or PD

PD.name: Progressive Disease
criteria: ≥20% increase in sum of longest diameters of CNS target lesions AND ≥5mm absolute increase
OR unequivocal progression in non-target lesions

local_vs_distant.local_failure: Progression at previously treated site (e.g., SRS field)
local_vs_distant.distant_failure: New brain metastasis outside treated area
